text:
I RAN A BOT THAT BOUGHT A $60 CHAIR WHILE I SLEPT. I SOLD IT FOR $240

At 7:12 my phone had three addresses on it and a note that said bring cash.

I had never seen any of those listings.

The whole edge is ninety seconds. On a local marketplace the good listing is gone in under an hour, and the person who answers first sets the price. So I stopped trying to be fast and gave the job to a worker that never sleeps, a Grok Bot agent running on its own machine in the cloud with my second account logged in.

Nine days later: 19 listings flagged, 6 bought, $680 spent, $1,610 back.

Here is the whole setup, 5 parts:

1. one rule, not a wishlist. buy only if the asking price is 35% under the median of what that exact model actually sold for in the last 30 days, and it checks that median before every message

2. it reads the photos, not the title. serial plate, model number, wear on the corners. a title lies, a photo of the back panel does not

3. no email trigger exists on this thing, so the feed gets checked on a schedule instead. mine runs every four minutes, and that is the only reason ninety seconds is possible

4. one offer, one line, no second round. "I can pick it up today at [price], cash." it never negotiates twice, because the second message is where sellers start shopping you around

5. it books the pickup straight into my calendar and stops. I approve, I drive, I pay. it never touches money

In nine days I did not message a single seller first.

Save this before your city figures it out ↓

quote.text:
Grok Bot is a legal cheat code

i pointed mine @bot at my Shopify store 10 days ago and stopped opening the admin, and those 10 days closed at $1,200 against $400 in the 10 before them

the stand i watch it on is one router and six bots: watcher scans 128 skus every four minutes, pricing checks six rivals and reprices only where the margin floor holds at 22%, writer rewrites the titles and pushes them live, support closes the tickets and escalates one, orders prints the labels, payout reports what Stripe cleared, and i read one message at 6am

build the same thing tonight, 3 moves:

1. connect Shopify and Stripe first, then let it list every other key it wants, and every key goes into a locked window one at a time, never into the chat

2. record yourself doing one job once and say "save that as a skill", then correct its output until it is worth your name, a routine takes two minutes here against fifteen in n8n

3. say "run that skill every morning at 6 and message me only if a number moves more than 10%", that one line is what turned it from a toy into a night shift

two catches sit in their own docs: you never pick the model, it is Grok 4.6 under the hood, and the X plugin reads but it cannot post

the part i keep thinking about is not the automation, every bot gets its own computer in the cloud that stays on with your laptop shut, so my store now has a night shift and i do not

save this, then send it to the one person you know who still checks their store at midnight, before they do another night of it ↓
